Author: GitHixy
Name: Aethermeter
Punchline: A damage and healing meter that lives inside the game.
Description:
Aethermeter is a combat meter drawn by the game itself: no external parser to start, nothing to attach.

WHAT YOU GET

- Damage, DPS, healing, HPS, damage taken, overhealing and deaths, live while you fight.
- Every pull kept as its own segment, plus an Overall segment across them.
- A breakdown for each player: abilities, crit and direct-hit rates, biggest hits, a damage graph and a recap of every death.
- As many meter windows as you like, each on its own view.
- Streamer mode: replace every player name with their job, or with initials.
- Bars, fonts, colours and layout you can tune to taste.

GETTING STARTED

Type /meter to show or hide the meter and /meter config for settings. /meter reset clears every segment.
Found a bug or have an idea? Come and talk about it on Discord: https://discord.gg/9kjUjWDBkJ

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Aethermeter only reads what your client already receives. It never posts to chat and never sends anything anywhere: numbers stay on your screen.
